headline: Space Needle 💉💥 Food Fest SHOOTOUT 🍔🔫 3 Dead, 2yo Hit 😭🔒
text: SEATTLE 🍎🌲 got hit with a TRAGIC 🍕💥 food-fest SHOOTOUT 🥪🔫 near the SPACE NEEDLE 🗼🪄! Two GUNMEN 🔫🤼‍♂️ went FULL GLOCK-TACULAR 🔫💨 and started BLASTIN' at each other like it's the O.K. CORRAL 🌵🔥! One BAD BOY 🦹‍♂️ got CUFFED 👮‍♂️⛓️, the other still GHOSTING 👻🏃‍♂️ but cops say NO MASS PANIC 🛑😌. Three lives GONE 😵💔, including a TINY 2-YEAR-OLD 🧒🍼 caught in the crossfire 😭🔥, plus several MORE HURT 🩹😢. Witnesses called it 'HORRIBLE CHAOS' 🫨🍟 as folks HID in the SPACE NEEDLE 🗼🛡️ like it's a FANCY BUNKER 🛖💎! Mayor KATIE WILSON 👩‍⚖️💬 thanked BRAVE COPS 🦸‍♂️🚓 who dropped the first SUSPECT like a HOT POTATO 🥔🔥! Governor BOB FERGUSON 🧔‍♂️📱 sent PRAYERS 🙏💔, Congresswoman PRAMILA JAYAPAL 👩‍💼💙 called it 'SENSELESS VIOLENCE' 🚫🔫, and the SPACE NEEDLE FLAG 🏳️‍🌈 dropped to HALF-MAST 🪦😔. Seattle's big FOODIE CELEBRATION 🥟🎉 turned into a GUNSHOW GONE WRONG 🔫🚫, but the city vows to HEAL ❤️‍🩹 and STAND TOGETHER 🤝🌃!
